description: Tick off fiber-rich foods or add your own to total daily fiber against 25g/30g targets.

faqs.a: About 25g per day for women and 30g for men are common reference targets; this tool lets you track against both.
faqs.q: How much fiber do I need?

faqs.a: Tick each food you ate today, or add a custom entry with its fiber grams from the nutrition label.
faqs.q: How do I log my foods?

faqs.a: Yes — fiber grams vary by brand and portion; treat the built-in values as typical averages.

howto: Tick every high-fiber food you ate today.
Add custom entries with fiber grams from labels.
Watch your total climb toward the target bar.
title: Fiber Intake Calculator
